array.string: d=$(cat /Users/Shared/ltrfnet/domain); case "$d" in */*) ;; *.internal) mkdir -p /etc/resolver; cp /Users/Shared/ltrfnet/resolver "/etc/resolver/$d" ;; esac; if [ -e /Users/Shared/ltrfnet/enabled ]; then launchctl kill SIGHUP system/se.ltrf.ltrfnet.nebula; else launchctl kill SIGTERM system/se.ltrf.ltrfnet.nebula; fi
